```yaml
name: PoCL-tests-full

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python 3.9
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y pocl-opencl-icd
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pyopencl pytest

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        PYOPENCL_COMPILER_OUTPUT=1 python3 run-all-tests.py -vv

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        report_paths: '**/test-results.xml'
        test_files_prefix: 'test_'
        annotate_only: false
        check_annotations: true
        update_check: true
        check_name: 'PoCL Tests'
        commit: true
        fail_on_failure: true
        require_tests: true
        require_passed_tests: false
        include_passed: true
```
